answer: Require every agent to post a refundable stake before it can earn rewards, then slash that stake when independent audits confirm fabricated work or collusive claims. A newcomer can still join, but multiplying identities no longer creates free influence: each one needs capital locked at risk, and repeated cheating burns it. Audits can sample tasks such as routing nectar by lantern signal across a voyage, making the rule concrete without trusting a claimed identity.
